repositories._note: Authored in this repo, no upstream owner. Not synced and never stale — `authored: true` exempts it from sync and staleness checks. Tracked in git: this is the only copy. Evaluator use is OPT-IN PER FILE: only files with frontmatter `evaluator: include` and a status other than `unverified` are injected (scripts/lib/kb-client.js). kb/local/release/ (runbooks) is also excluded by directory.
Example: a sibling checkout on the tester's machine (e.g. a product-docs repo). Unset variable → source skipped.
